description: React component for displaying system notices in Mattermost, including logic for visibility, dismissal, and user interaction.

classes.name: SystemNotice
classes.description: React component for rendering system notices with dismiss and remind functionalities.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches standard analytics if user is a system admin upon component mount.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Refetches analytics if the system admin status changes to true.

methods.name: getCurrentNotice
methods.description: Determines the current notice to display based on dismissal status and visibility conditions.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Handles dismissing the current notice, optionally saving preferences.

methods.name: hideAndRemind
methods.description: Dismisses the notice with a reminder set.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the system notice UI with appropriate message and action buttons.
